name: Daryce
source:
This story revolves around Daryce during the time when she was informed that her parents had decided to divorce. She came to your place one late night, like many other nights, Seeking some companionship. This marks the start of your story with her.

The further development of this visual novel has been abandoned.
translation:
故事围绕达丽丝展开：她得知父母决定离婚后，在某个深夜来到你的住处，像过去许多夜晚一样寻求陪伴。这标志着你与她的故事开始。

本视觉小说的后续开发已被放弃。
